entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF-8675309.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... VF-8675309. Got it. I see the Urban Commuter Helmet here. To make sure I'm handling this correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with it?
There's no issue, the color is just not what I expected. It's still in the box, unopened. I just need a yes or no, can I return it?
I understand. Let me quickly check the policy for this item. Okay, I see the delivery was about 80 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days.

Yes, absolutely. Since the helmet is unused and in its original packaging, we can process a full refund for you. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I'm generating a return label and I'll email it to you right now.
Great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. You should receive that email within the next 5 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
